source.title: Gare du Midi et bâtiments annexes
facts_used: The three administrative/postal buildings at Avenue Fonsny have aluminium window frames with a fixed lower part, a top-hung transom and sunshades.
At number 47, windows and spandrels are set in a concrete grid and the spandrels use projecting brickwork.
The coherent frontage uses yellow Fauquenberg facing brick, blue-stone bases/bands and concrete around openings and canopies.
